Sub: Intimation of earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended September 30,

Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that an earnings 
conference call is scheduled to be held on Wednesday, November 04, 2026 at 05:00 P.M. (IST) to 
discuss the Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 
30, 2026. 
 
Dial-in details are enclosed herewith. 
 
The details of the call will also be posted on the Company’s website at https://xtranetindia.com/. 
 
We request you to take the same on record.  
 
Thanking You,  
Yours Sincerely, 
 
For Xtranet Technologies Limited
